name: AstroImageJ
description: Targeted retained-source read supports the narrow Tier A behavior for this primary application updater: AstroImageJ computes the downloaded file hash, parses the detached Sigstore bundle, and verifies it with a Fulcio identity constraint pinned to the repository workflow.
limitations: The retained snapshot does not establish current released artifact signing or deployment state beyond the checked-in pinned key/configuration.
Framework verification depends on the packaged updater implementation where the application delegates to Sparkle or tauri-plugin-updater.
